variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
